premises.text: A marketplace lets designers sell professional-level 3D printable files instead of giving them away
premises.evidence_span: marketplace where designers can sell professional level 3D printable files rather than just giving them away

premises.text: Buyers can purchase, download, and manufacture digitized objects at home
premises.evidence_span: digitized objects that you can purchase, download, and manufacture right from the comfort of your home

premises.text: Built-in customization and a network of print shops serve buyers without their own 3D printers
premises.evidence_span: with our 1,000 3D print shops in our network, you can order something from across the world and literally pick it up from across the street

premises.text: Revenue comes from design sales and print profits while printer competition lowers prices
premises.evidence_span: we generate revenue from the design and profit from the sale of print

premises.text: Designers can open a store quickly and earn passive income from their creations
premises.evidence_span: a designer can open a store on 3DLT and start selling their creations

value.text: Choose when, where, and how the products you buy are manufactured via 3D printable designs
value.evidence_span: We give you the power to choose when, where, and how the products you buy are manufactured

secondary_value.text: Designers turn passion into passive income
secondary_value.evidence_span: turn their passion into passive income

causal_links.evidence_span: purchase, download, and manufacture right from the comfort of your home

notes: Vision claims ('change the way you buy everything', 'final frontier', future demand flip) not coded as premises (§4.1(4)); primary value captures the manufacturing-choice criterion. Catalog examples and size customization folded into marketplace/print premises (§4.1(5)). Free-credit promotion and market-size framing excluded. Singletons D2/D3 justified: fulfillment network and take-rate model are separately revisable from the design catalog.
